questions.prompt: Which country did Japan attack at Pearl Harbor in 1941?
questions.fact: The aircraft carriers the attack was meant to destroy happened to be at sea that morning.

questions.prompt: Which structure separates the chest from the abdomen?
questions.fact: Hiccups are involuntary spasms of it, and no one has a complete explanation for what purpose they serve.

questions.prompt: Which sport features the Tour Championship and FedEx Cup?
questions.fact: The format resets scores before the final event, so a player can win the title without winning the tournament.

questions.prompt: Which television programme features the phrase you are the weakest link?
questions.fact: Its deliberately hostile presenting style was licensed along with the format to dozens of countries.

questions.prompt: Which country contains the Cliffs of Moher?
questions.fact: They rise to over 200 metres and appear in a long list of films standing in for other coastlines.

questions.prompt: Which term describes a poem written in praise of something?
questions.fact: Keats wrote five of them in a single spring, which is generally counted among the great bursts in English poetry.

questions.prompt: Which company created the Ansible automation tool?
questions.fact: Its name comes from a fictional faster-than-light communication device in science fiction.
